user.title: MoistureLoop
user.description: Create the MoistureLoop controller. Add irrigation zones afterwards with 'Add zone'.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one MoistureLoop controller is supported.

user.title: Zone identity
user.description: Name this zone, then choose the sensor that measures its soil moisture and the switch or valve that waters it. {shared_sensor_warning}

data_description.name: Shown on this zone's device and entities.
data_description.moisture_sensor: The Home Assistant sensor MoistureLoop reads to decide when this zone needs water.
data_description.actuator: The switch or valve that turns this zone's water on and off.

thresholds.title: Thresholds and timing
thresholds.description: MoistureLoop starts automatic watering when soil moisture falls below the start threshold. It waters in pulses, waits for the soil to soak, then checks a fresh moisture reading. Watering finishes when the target is reached or a safety limit is reached. {shared_sensor_warning}

data_description.start_threshold: Watering can start when soil moisture falls below this level. 1 to 99%.
data_description.target_threshold: Watering stops once a fresh moisture reading reaches or exceeds this level. Must be above the start threshold. 2 to 100%.
data_description.pulse_duration: How long the valve stays open for each watering pulse. 30 to 1800 seconds (30 seconds to 30 minutes).
data_description.soak_duration: How long MoistureLoop waits after each pulse before using a new moisture reading. 60 to 14400 seconds (1 minute to 4 hours).

limits.title: Safety limits
limits.description: These limits prevent excessive watering and set how fresh the sensor and valve responses must be. New zones start disabled, so you can review these settings before enabling automatic watering. {shared_sensor_warning}

data_description.max_cycles: Maximum number of watering pulses allowed in one automatic session. 1 to 20.
data_description.max_session_runtime: Maximum total valve-open time allowed during one watering session. At least the pulse duration, up to 14400 seconds (4 hours).
data_description.max_daily_runtime: Maximum total valve-open time this zone may use in one day. At least the pulse duration, up to 43200 seconds (12 hours).
data_description.min_session_interval: Minimum time between completed automatic watering sessions. 900 to 604800 seconds (15 minutes to 7 days).
data_description.sensor_max_age: Moisture reports older than this are considered stale and cannot start watering. Age is measured from the report timestamp Home Assistant exposes, so pick a sensor that keeps reporting this often even when its value does not change. 300 to 86400 seconds (5 minutes to 24 hours).
data_description.actuator_confirm_timeout: How long MoistureLoop waits for the switch or valve to confirm that it opened or closed. 5 to 300 seconds (5 seconds to 5 minutes).
data_description.manual_max_duration: Maximum duration allowed for a single manual watering request. 60 to 7200 seconds (1 minute to 2 hours).

reconfigure.description: Update this zone's name, sensor, or watering switch or valve. Saving a change safely stops any watering that is in progress first. {shared_sensor_warning}

error.duplicate_name: Another zone already uses this name (names are compared case-insensitively).
error.wrong_domain: This entity type cannot be used for this field.
error.valve_features_missing: This valve cannot be commanded open and closed, so it cannot be used. Position-only valves are not supported.
error.duplicate_actuator: Another zone already uses this switch or valve.
error.actuator_identity_conflict: This switch or valve conflicts with the watering history MoistureLoop kept for it. Restore the original entity, or pick a different one, before continuing.
error.target_not_above_start: The target threshold must be higher than the start threshold.
error.invalid_configuration: One or more values are outside their allowed range. Check that the maximum watering per session and per day are both at least as long as the pulse duration.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Zone updated. Any previously active session was safely terminated.

start_manual_watering.name: Start manual watering
start_manual_watering.description: Start an explicit, bounded manual watering session for one zone. The effective duration is clamped by the manual maximum, session maximum, and remaining daily budget.

stop_watering.name: Stop watering
stop_watering.description: Cooperatively stop the zone's active session. A no-op in inactive states.

evaluate_zone.name: Check zone
evaluate_zone.description: Run a normal guarded automatic check of whether the zone should water now. Bypasses nothing.

clear_fault.name: Clear fault
clear_fault.description: Acknowledge/clear the zone's fault when its safety condition is resolved.

device_not_found.message: No device with this ID exists.

not_a_zone_device.message: The selected device is not a MoistureLoop zone.

entry_not_loaded.message: The MoistureLoop controller is not loaded.

zone_not_ready.message: The zone runtime is not ready.

zone_not_active.message: This zone no longer has an active configured runtime.

reconciliation_busy.message: The configuration is being reconciled. Try again after the current configuration is safely applied.

reconciliation_failed.message: Configuration reconciliation failed. Watering controls remain blocked until a current configuration is successfully applied.

invalid_duration.message: The requested duration must be a positive number of seconds.

session_active.message: A session is already active for this zone.

fault_blocks_manual.message: The active fault does not permit manual watering.

actuator_not_ready.message: The actuator is not available and proven off.

daily_budget_exhausted.message: The daily watering budget is exhausted.

water_resource_occupied.message: Another configured actuator is or may be flowing.

fault_not_clearable.message: The fault condition is not resolved or requires reconfiguration.

request_refused.message: The request was refused by the zone's safety guards.

zone_sensor_missing.title: Moisture sensor missing for {zone_name}
zone_sensor_missing.description: The configured soil-moisture sensor {entity_id} no longer exists. The zone is blocked until it is reconfigured with a valid sensor.

zone_actuator_missing.title: Irrigation actuator missing for {zone_name}
zone_actuator_missing.description: The configured irrigation actuator {entity_id} no longer exists. The zone is blocked until it is reconfigured, and any unresolved water-resource blocker is retained.

tombstone_actuator_missing.title: Retained actuator identity is unresolved for {zone_name}
tombstone_actuator_missing.description: Safety record {safety_record_id} ({lifecycle}) cannot resolve its durable actuator identity ({entity_id}, Registry ID {registry_entry_id}). All watering stays blocked until this is resolved. Restore the original entity identity, or reconfigure the zone; this issue cannot safely adopt a different entity. If the actuator was permanently removed, MoistureLoop offers a confirmation step once the removal is definitive rather than merely unavailable. Details: {detail}

confirm.title: Removed irrigation actuator
confirm.description:
Home Assistant can no longer find the actuator previously used by this removed zone ({entity_id}). MoistureLoop is blocking all automatic and manual watering because it cannot prove that actuator is off.

Only confirm this after checking the irrigation hardware. MoistureLoop will then release this retired safety record so other zones can water.

This does not start watering, and it does not change any zone's settings or enabled state.

data.actuator_removed_off: I confirm that this removed actuator is physically off and can no longer deliver water

data_description.actuator_removed_off: Check the hardware first. This is a safety confirmation, not a way to dismiss the message.

error.record_entry_not_loaded: The owning MoistureLoop entry is not loaded.
error.record_removal_not_confirmed: This actuator is no longer definitively removed, or the retained record changed. MoistureLoop keeps blocking watering until it can prove the actuator is off.
error.record_confirmation_required: Tick the confirmation to certify that the removed actuator is physically off.
error.record_acknowledgement_failed: The confirmation could not be durably saved. The Repair remains open and watering stays blocked.

actuator_identity_conflict.title: Actuator identity conflict for {zone_name}
actuator_identity_conflict.description: Safety record {safety_record_id} has conflicting durable actuator identity evidence for {entity_id} (Registry ID {registry_entry_id}). Reconfigure or restore the original entity identity; a replacement actuator cannot inherit this record's hazard. Details: {detail}

configuration_reconciliation_failed.title: MoistureLoop configuration reconciliation failed
configuration_reconciliation_failed.description: Entry {entry_id} could not safely apply configuration generation {observed_generation}; the last applied generation is {applied_generation}. Watering admission remains closed. Details: {error}

actuator_off_unconfirmed.title: Water may still be flowing in {zone_name}

confirm.title: Acknowledge retained actuator fault
confirm.description: Acknowledge only after actuator {entity_id} is physically OFF. This flow will revalidate exact safety record {safety_record_id}, lineage {safety_lineage_id}, blockers ({blockers}), and accounting ({accounting}) before clearing its acknowledgement-required fault.

error.record_entry_not_loaded: The owning MoistureLoop entry is not loaded.
error.record_not_found: The exact retained safety record is missing or has been superseded.
error.record_fault_changed: The exact record no longer has the acknowledgement fault referenced by this Repair.
error.record_fault_not_acknowledgeable: This fault cannot be acknowledged by this flow.
error.record_identity_unresolved: The exact actuator identity is missing or conflicting.
error.record_off_not_proven: The exact actuator is not proven OFF, or its blockers/accounting remain open.
error.record_acknowledgement_failed: The acknowledgement could not be durably verified. The Repair remains open.

runtime_store_integrity_lost.title: MoistureLoop safety history lost
runtime_store_integrity_lost.description: The runtime safety store is missing, corrupt, or does not match this installation. All automatic and manual watering is blocked, today's budget is treated as exhausted, and acknowledgement is required after every actuator is proven OFF.
